chunks: Peace be upon him: O God, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O God, send prayer upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O God, make me among those of the Testament and Faith
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication asking for the right of Muhammad and his family?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, emphasizes the theological concept of *al-wilayah* (divine authority) of the Ahl al-Bayt as the means to attain God’s acceptance, reflecting the Shia emphasis on intercession through the Prophet and his progeny. It serves as a practical expression of loyalty (*tawalla*) to the Imams, linking righteous action with the spiritual lineage of the Prophet. The text underscores the belief that true faith is validated through adherence to the guidance of the Imams, a core tenet in Shia jurisprudence and theology.
